newsitem.title: USA: Magnetek adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Magnetek adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: MagneTek Inc said on Thursday it adopted a stockholder rights plan, but added that it has received no unsolicited acquisition proposals "at this time."
The rights plan would be triggered if somebody acquired at least 15 percent of the company's outstanding shares, which on Thursday morning were trading at 17-7/8.
Wednesday's closing price of 18 equaled MagneTek's 52-week high.
MagnaTek makes integrated electrical products, including electric motors and generators. Sales for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1996, were $1.2 billion.
